boundaries.authoring: Geometry chosen by Codex, executed through editor-core agent commands; not an independent live CLI/MCP generation session
boundaries.variantManagement: Initial illustrative fixtures used local human-owned snapshots. Studio 0.16.0 now additionally permits append-only agent drafts; restore/delete/checkpoint and human metadata remain protected.
boundaries.textures: Neutral blockout only; painted texture not accepted
boundaries.generalAgentVariantWorkflow: IMPLEMENTED; local MCP/GUI proof PASS, independent model turn/full matrix/hosted not yet terminal
boundaries.hosted: Previous 035 evidence applies to old runtime only; 0.16.0 hosted proof still required
boundaries.scope: Reproducible drafts and local proofs only; point 036 remains unchecked

agentRuntime.operation: draftVariant: closed append-only snapshot of current scene, three agent drafts/four total, manual baseline immutable, no model/path/approval payload
agentRuntime.geometryFilter: Placed cuboid corner sets, normalized to 1e-6; ignores IDs/colors/UV and exact duplicate cuboids; not an artistic difference score

sdk.snapshotCreation: All three drafts created through MCP preview/apply; operator created only manual baseline
